bard_appearancebonus.description: AppearanceBonus (7 CP): The character gains a +1 bonus to their Charisma/Appearance score.  Their Appearance score can be up to 5 points higher than their Leadership score, instead of the maximum of four points.  The subability may not exceed 18 with this bonus.

bard_detectlie.description: DetectLie (10 CP): A Bard learns to study people and is an excellent observer of the habits and nuances of body language and what they signify.  They are adept at telling when someone is lying to them or being evasive.  The Bard does not know the specifics of any falsehoods--they only know if the speaker is lying to them.  If the speaker is an exceptionally good liar or actor, the DM may secretly roll a Wisdom/Intuition check for the Bard.  If the check fails, the Bard does not detect a lie or an evasion in a statement or answer.  If, however, the check succeeds, the Bard can sense the speaker is lying.  The DM may penalize the Intuition check if the speaker is a Rogue, unusually eloquent, or wary of what they say to the Bard.  The Bard cannot verify the accuracy of what someone says, only if they are intentionally lying or not.

bard_fascinate.description: Fascinate (5 CP): The Bard has a magnetic personality that fascinates people.  Their voice is hypnotic and their eyes are alluring.  People meeting the Bard seem to like them instantly.  When the Bard speaks or sings, people in the room fall silent to listen.  When talking to a group of people, the Bard receives a -1 Bonus to their reaction rolls, in addition to any other bonuses they might have.  When talking to one or two people, the Bard receives a -2 Bonus to their reaction rolls.  Furthermore, if the reaction of the listeners is "Friendly" they act as if under the influence of a Suggestion spell for the next round.  They do their best to do what the Bard asks, freely answering all of their questions.  As long as the Bard does not abuse their influence or ask for anything out of character from the listeners, they do not feel manipulated or tricked.  Creatures of <5 Intelligence, undead, and animated or summoned monsters are immune to this power.

bard_good_reputation.description: Good Reputation (5 CP): The Bard has a popular reputation in the area, and people are familiar with their talents.  The Bard's name has become common knowledge and their abilities are in demand.  With their reputation, the Bard can travel from place to place, living off the goodwill their name generates.  They can acquire free room and board, free drinks, and the occasional small gift.  In game terms, the Bard gains a -2 Bonus to reaction rolls after they mention their name in conversation.  If the reaction they receive is favorable, they can ask for free lodging, information, or food and expect to receive it.  If the reaction is unfavorable, they first must prove their namesake by entertaining the disbelievers.  After that, they may make another reaction check with a -4 bonus.  Failure indicates the Bard's name is unfamiliar to the listeners or that they just aren't impressed.  In exchange for the goodwill and gifts, people expect the Bard to entertain them wherever the Bard goes, often for hours at a time.  If the Bard refuses, it damages their reputation.  If the Bard continually turns down requests to entertain, their reputation suffers permanent harm.

bard_learning_bonus.description: Learning Bonus (5 CP): The Bard is adept at learning new things.  This bonus allows them to purchase all NWPs at 1 point under normal cost (minimum 1 point).  For example, the NWP Ancient History normally costs 3 points.  For a Bard with Learning Bonus, the proficiency only costs 2 points.  When learning languages, the Bard pays the full normal NWP cost, but receives two languages instead of one for the price.

cleric_immunity_to_magic.description: Immunity to magic (15): Partial immunity to one type of magic (alteration, invocation, necromancy, etc.): +4 to saves, or a save against effects that normally allow none.

cleric_immunity_to_disease.description: Immunity to natural disease (10): Immune to normal diseases. Magical diseases such as lycanthropy and mummy rot still apply.

cleric_restriction_behavior_taboo.description: Restriction - Behavior/taboo (2): Priest's religion requires an unusual code of conduct (e.g., pray before crossing every river, must always cast cure spells on anyone in need); violating it requires penance to regain spells. Gain 2 CP.

cleric_restriction_ceremony_observance.description: Restriction - Ceremony/observance (5): Priest must perform a mandatory daily ceremony (prayer at sunrise, daily sacrifice, lengthy nightly atonement); missing it risks losing memorized spells or suffering divine disfavor. Gain 5 CP.

cleric_restriction_fanaticism.description: Restriction - Fanaticism (5): Priest's faith is intolerant — refuses non-worshipping companions and suffers a −4 reaction adjustment with any NPC not of his faith. Gain 5 CP.

cleric_restriction_limited_spell_selecti.description: Restriction - Limited spell selection (5): Priest must build a spell book like a wizard; spells per level capped by Intelligence, and a learn-spells roll is required to add each new spell. Gain 5 CP.

cleric_restriction_talisman.description: Restriction - Talisman/symbol (8): Priest's spell powers are focused through one holy symbol; without it, no spells can be cast. Creating a replacement takes 1d4 weeks of prayer, meditation, and fasting at his home temple. Gain 8 CP.

fighter_improved_thac0.description: Improved Thac0 (10 CP): The PC begins life better suited than most, to fight, by having an improved Thac0.  The PC starts with a Thac0 of 18 at 1st level that improves by 1 for every level advance.

fighter_proficiency_ease.description: Proficiency Ease (5 CP): By spending 5 CPs now, the fighter can cut the cost of all weapon proficiency costs in the future (including all forms of mastery) by 50%

fighter_anomalous_intuition.description: Anomalous Intuition (10 CP): Like many heroes of literature and myth, this warrior maintains an unexplained connection with some mysterious power or magical entity.  Perhaps they have divine parentage, as did Hercules, or maybe their mother was years ago blessed by fairy folk, and the warrior still--perhaps unknowingly--carries this blessing.  At the least, the character has a distant kinship with elves or a similar magical race, and retains and echo of their power.  Whether they are aware of its origins or not, the Warrior with Anomalous Intuition has the uncanny ability to detect things that are normally beyond the range of mortal perception.  By simply passing within a few feet of a secret door, the character has a 1-in-6 chance of sensing its existence, or a 1-in-3 chance if the Warrior is an elf.  Furthermore, their hunches or their 'gut' guide them when danger is afoot.  The Warrior possesses the equivalent of the Trouble Sense proficiency as detailed in Player's Options: Combat and Tactics, pg 80

fighter_athleticism.description: Athleticism (10 CP): A Warrior with this talent is the physical epitome of the epic Greek athletes of ancient Athens.  Robust and naturally fit, a Fighter with this skill is capable of heroic feats of bodily prowess and puissance.  They epitomize the animal grace of the humanoid form.  As a result of their strength and agility, the Warrior receives a +2/+10% bonus to all checks involving running, jumping, throwing and climbing.  Furthermore, they can purchase the Endurance proficiency for half the standard cost.

fighter_blood_oath.description: Blood Oath (5 CP): Much like the Ranger's special racial enmity, this option allows the player to select a certain type of creature as their character's blood enemy.  Whenever they are faced with their chosen foe, the Warrior enjoys a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls.  However, their hatred toward this enemy is so great that it requires an enormous effort of willpower to resist an opportunity to combat this foe.  If the Warrior wishes to avoid a confrontation, they must make a Wisdom/Willpower check to see if they have the force of will to turn around and walk away.  If they fail, the Blood Oath gets the best of them and they charge forward, teeth bared and weapons flashing.

fighter_combat_sense.description: Combat Sense (10 CP): By selecting this skill, the Fighter enjoys an innate kinship with the pulse of battle, enabling them to act with more precision and accuracy than others who are less comfortable in melee situations.  They receive a +1 bonus in three different combat situations: 1) Fighting in the dark (reducing the penalty to -3 instead of the standard -4, or -1 if the Fighter knows the Blindfighting NWP); 2) Attacking opponents who are partially or wholly concealed (reducing all penalties by 1, as per PHB); 3) Surprise (the Fighters chance of being Surprised is reduced by 1 in 10)

fighter_comitatus.description: Comitatus (5 CP): By purchasing this option, the player is essentially entering their character into a feudal contract.  The exact interpretation of this pact is the domain of the DM, but the Comitatus generally entitles the character to a special favor or privilege from their liege lord or other powerful NPC.  For example, in return for protecting the region from local brigands, the Fighter can expect food and lodging from the Baron of the land.  On a greater scale, a Warrior in command of their own castle may be responsible for the housing and upkeep of several platoons of the King's army.  In exchange, he is granted legal protection and various privileges normally reserved exclusively for nobility.  Comitatus was the old Danish practice of swearing brotherhood between a thane and their vassals.  Certain duties were expected of the vassal, but in return for their loyalty, they could expect an occasional favor from their lord.  The player is encouraged to develop a story behind this relationship and should manipulate the Comitatus to be consistent with the campaign.  Comitatus is not restricted to a liege and their vassal; the player is free to form the Comitatus with any appropriate NPC: guildmaster, sage, city alderman, etc.  As long as they are faithful to the relationship, the character can expect an occasional petty favor from their benefactor, as governed by the DM.

fighter_concentrated_strength.description: Concentrated Strength (5 CP): Though they might not be capable of sudden bursts of intense power, the Warrior choosing this option can apply a great deal of muscle to a single task requiring concentration and will.  In effect, this is the difference between the Open Doors check (which requires a quick application of motion and muscle) and the Bend Bars percentage (which relies upon a deep inner focus and the steady increase of continous pressure).  By opting for this ability, the character doubles their normal chances of Bending Bars and Lifting Gates.

fighter_coup_de_gras.description: Coup de Gras (10 CP): The Coup de Gras is the Warrior's signature strike, the stroke of grace that ends combat with a single blow and inspires Bards to compose epic poetry, romanticizing the battle.  If the Critical Hit rules from Combat & Tactics are in use, the Coup de Gras translates into a considerable bonus to the Warrior who succeeds in scoring a critical strike.  Before rolling for the severity of the blow, the Warrior makes a Strength/Muscle check.  If successful, their weapon is considered to be one size larger than usual, so that a size M Longsword is now size L, while a two-handed sword is considered a size H weapon for purposes of critical hits.  If the critical hit tables are not in effect, the Warrior with the Coup de Gras power is still entitled to additional damage whenever their attack roll is a natural 18, 19 or 20 and is at least five points above the required roll to hit.  In these cases, the Warrior inflict double damage.

fighter_heroic_boast.description: Heroic Boast (5 CP): Much like mythic Beowulf, a Fighter with this option has the ability to rouse the morale of their comrades.  By uttering a brief, passionate oration on their prowess in battle and the glory to be won a Fighter can inspire friendly NPCs, granting them a +2 to morale for the duration of the upcoming struggle, so long as the Fighter is leading them.  This skill should be roleplayed by the player to be effective.

fighter_iaijutsu.description: Iaijutsu (5 CP): As adapted from the 1st Edition Oriental Adventures rulebook, Iaijutsu allows the Warrior to unsheath their weapon with startling speed.  A successful Dexterity/Balance check means that the Warrior suffers no delay in terms of game rounds when removing or returning their weapon from and to its scabbard.

fighter_mettle.description: Mettle (10 CP): Like many legendary heroes, the Warrior with this natural gift possesses a near indestructible frame; indeed he seems to be cast of iron.  With bones that are inherently resilient, this character has a Herculean fortitude that allows them to resist the punishment of bludgeoning weapons and falling damage.  Any damage from these attack forms is halved if the Warrior makes a successful Constitution/Fitness check.

fighter_mythic_lore.description: Mythic Lore (10 CP): In their youth, this Fighter spent many sleepless nights listening to the tales of magnificent Warriors and their weapons.  The Fighter now has a 5% chance per level of knowing the history of any magical or legendary weapon or piece of armor, as well as facts concerning the known owners of those items.

fighter_war_cry.description: War Cry (5 CP): By uttering a withering battle cry seconds before striking, a Fighter with this skill receives a +1 bonus to damage rolls for a single strike.  This strike must always be the Fighter's first in any combat situation, used as they engage the enemy for the first time.  This skill may be used a number of times per day equal to the character's level, but never more than once in any battle.

fighter_shield_mastery.description: Shield mastery (8): Gain +1 AC while using any shield.

fighter_battle_hardened.description: Battle hardened (10): +1 bonus on all saving throws.

paladin_resist_charm.description: Resist charm (10): +2 bonus to saves vs charm-like effects.

paladin_saving_throw_bonus.description: Saving throw bonus (10): +2 bonus to all saving throws.

paladin_turn_undead.description: Turn undead (10): Turn undead as a cleric two levels lower, starting at 3rd level.

psionicist_extra_power_points_10.description: Extra power points +10/level (18): Gain 10 additional power points per experience level.

psionicist_defense_mode_bonus.description: Bonus defense mode (10): Know one additional defense mode at 1st level (normally gained at later levels).

psionicist_wild_talent.description: Wild talent (5): Gain one random wild talent devotion in addition to regular powers.

psionicist_mental_armor.description: Mental armor (10): Psionic AC bonus of +1 when not wearing physical armor (stacks with DEX bonus).

psionicist_power_point_recovery.description: Rapid recovery (8): Regain power points at double the normal rate during rest.

psionicist_psionic_attack_bonus.description: Focused mind (12): +1 to psionic attack scores (MTHAC0); psionic combat rolls are more accurate.

psionicist_contact_mastery.description: Contact mastery (8): Make psionic contact as a free action once per round (normally costs action).

psionicist_mindbender.description: Mindbender (12): When using Telepathy devotions, save penalties for targets are increased by 1.

psionicist_body_mastery.description: Body mastery (10): Psychometabolism devotions cost 1 fewer power point (minimum 1).

psionicist_telekinetic_force.description: Telekinetic force (10): +25% to mass limits for all Psychokinesis devotions.

psionicist_clairvoyant_sense.description: Clairvoyant sense (8): Clairsentience devotion range increased by 50%.

psionicist_metapsionic_link.description: Metapsionic link (15): May apply one Metapsionics devotion to another power as a free action once per day.

psionicist_restriction_one_discipline.description: Restriction - Single discipline focus: Gain 15 CP (locked to one primary discipline, cannot access others until high level).

psionicist_restriction_no_combat_modes.description: Restriction - No psionic combat modes: Gain 20 CP (use only contact-based powers, no attack modes).

psionicist_mental_bastion.description: Mental bastion (10): +1 bonus to saving throws versus mind-affecting magic and psionics.

psionicist_celerity.description: Psionic celerity (8): +1 initiative-like surprise response through precognitive flashes.

wizard_resist_sleep_charm.description: Resistance to sleep and charm (5): +1 to saves vs sleep and charm.

wizard_weapon_specialization.description: Weapon specialization (15): May specialize in one weapon (costs paid separately).

wizard_priestly_wizard_cp15.description: Priestly wizard (15): Gain minor or major priest sphere access cast with wizard slots.

wizard_signature_spell_levels_1_3.description: Signature spell I (levels 1-3, 2 CP): Choose one signature spell for levels 1-3.

wizard_signature_spell_levels_4_6.description: Signature spell II (levels 4-6, 4 CP): Choose one signature spell for levels 4-6.

wizard_signature_spell_levels_7_9.description: Signature spell III (levels 7-9, 6 CP): Choose one signature spell for levels 7-9.

wizard_enhanced_casting_level.description: Enhanced casting level (10): Once per day, cast spells of one chosen school as if 1d4 levels higher (roll each use).

wizard_followers.description: Followers (10): Automatically attract 20-200 0-level men-at-arms and 1d6 apprentice wizards (levels 1-3) at 8th level upon establishing a stronghold.

wizard_immunity.description: Immunity (10+): Complete immunity to one spell (10 CP + 1 CP/spell level). Immunity to a group of related spells costs points equal to the highest-level spell in that group.

wizard_learning_bonus_cp5.description: Learning bonus (5): +15% to learn spells of one school (5 CP) or +25% (7 CP). Double cost to apply to all schools.

wizard_learning_bonus_cp7.description: Learning bonus (7): +15% to learn spells of one school (5 CP) or +25% (7 CP). Double cost to apply to all schools.

wizard_persistent_spell_effect.description: Persistent spell effect (15+2/spell level): One known spell has a persistent effect as long as you concentrate; give up a spell slot of that level. Only self-affecting, non-instantaneous spells qualify.

wizard_proficiency_crossovers.description: Proficiency group crossovers (5+): Select NWP from an additional character group (warrior, priest, rogue, etc.) at no penalty. 5 CP per extra group.

wizard_research_bonus.description: Research bonus (5+): Spells of one school count as one level lower for spell research. Double cost to apply to all schools.

wizard_school_knowledge_cp5.description: School knowledge (5): Deep expertise in one school grants +1 bonus to saves vs. that school's spells and imposes -1 penalty to opponents' saves. For 8 CP, bonuses increase to +2/-2.

wizard_school_knowledge_cp8.description: School knowledge (8): Deep expertise in one school grants +1 bonus to saves vs. that school's spells and imposes -1 penalty to opponents' saves. For 8 CP, bonuses increase to +2/-2.

wizard_constitution_adjustment.description: Constitution adjustment (5): Use the warrior Constitution-based HP bonus (+3/+4 per Hit Die with Con 17/18 instead of maximum +2).

wizard_improved_hit_die_d8.description: Improved hit die (20): Use a d8 for hit points instead of d4. (For d6, use hit point bonus at 10 CP.)

wizard_specialist_alchemist.description: Alchemist specialist package: +1 save vs Alchemy spells, bonus Alchemy spell per level, know all Alchemy spells. Opposition: Illusion & Necromancy.

wizard_specialist_transmuter.description: Transmuter specialist package: +1 save vs Alteration spells, bonus Alteration spell per level, know all Alteration spells. Opposition: Abjuration & Necromancy.

wizard_specialist_conjurer.description: Conjurer specialist package: +1 save vs Conjuration/Summoning spells, bonus Conj. spell per level, know all Conj. spells. Opposition: Greater Divination & Invocation/Evocation.

wizard_specialist_diviner.description: Diviner specialist package: +1 save vs Divination spells, bonus Divination spell per level, know all Divination spells. Opposition: Conjuration/Summoning.

wizard_specialist_enchanter.description: Enchanter specialist package: +1 save vs Enchantment/Charm spells, bonus Enchantment spell per level, know all Enchantment spells. Opposition: Invocation/Evocation & Necromancy.

wizard_specialist_geometer.description: Geometer specialist package: +1 save vs Geometry spells, bonus Geometry spell per level. Uses geometric formulae for unique spells. Opposition: Enchantment/Charm & Illusion.

wizard_specialist_illusionist.description: Illusionist specialist package: +1 save vs Illusion spells, bonus Illusion spell per level, know all Illusion spells. Opposition: Necromancy, Invocation/Evocation & Abjuration.

wizard_specialist_invoker.description: Invoker specialist package: +1 save vs Invocation/Evocation spells, bonus Invocation spell per level, know all Invocation spells. Opposition: Enchantment/Charm & Conjuration/Summoning.

wizard_specialist_necromancer.description: Necromancer specialist package: +1 save vs Necromancy spells, bonus Necromancy spell per level, know all Necromancy spells. Opposition: Illusion & Enchantment/Charm.

wizard_specialist_shadow.description: Shadow Wizard specialist package: +1 save vs Shadow spells, bonus Shadow spell per level. Draws power from the Plane of Shadow. Opposition: Abjuration & Invocation/Evocation.

wizard_specialist_song_wizard.description: Song Wizard specialist package: +1 save vs Song spells, bonus Song spell per level. Uses musical magic of Elven tradition. Opposition: Divination, Invocation/Evocation & Necromancy.

wizard_restriction_learning_penalty.description: Restriction - Learning penalty outside favored school: Choose a favored school; spells from other schools are harder to learn.

wizard_restriction_limited_magical_item_.description: Restriction - Limited magical item use: Select barred magical item categories.

wizard_restriction_reduced_spell_progres.description: Restriction - Reduced spell progression: Reduce arcane slot progression by one slot at each spell level where slots are available.

wizard_restriction_awkward_casting_metho.description: Restriction - Awkward casting method (5): Wizard's spellcasting is extremely obvious — brilliant lights, shouted components, or waves of sensation alert anyone nearby. Casting from ambush or discretely is nearly impossible. Gain 5 CP.

wizard_restriction_hazardous_spells.description: Restriction - Hazardous spells (10): Each time wizard casts a spell, must save vs. breath weapon or suffer 1 damage per spell level; or a cumulative 1%/level chance of insanity lasting 3d4 days. Gain 10 CP.

wizard_restriction_reduced_hit_points.description: Restriction - Reduced hit points (10): Uses d3 Hit Die instead of d4; Constitution hit point bonus capped at +1 per die. Gain 10 CP.

wizard_restriction_reduced_spell_knowled.description: Restriction - Reduced spell knowledge (7): Maximum spells known per level is halved from the Intelligence-based limit.

wizard_restriction_slower_casting_time_c.description: Restriction - Slower casting time (2): Arcane cast times under one round gain +3; cast times of one round or longer are doubled.
Restriction - Slower casting time (5): Arcane cast times under one round become one full round; rounds escalate to turns (and larger units step up similarly).

wizard_restriction_behavior_taboo.description: Restriction - Behavior/taboo (2): Wizard must follow an unusual code of behavior (specific dress, food avoidance, no physical contact, etc.); violating it causes loss of all memorized spells. Gain 2 CP.

wizard_restriction_difficult_memorizatio.description: Restriction - Difficult memorization (5): Wizard can only memorize spells under very specific circumstances (e.g., only in his lab, in a temple of the god of magic, or after a full-day rite). Gain 5 CP.

wizard_restriction_environmental_conditi.description: Restriction - Environmental condition (5+): Wizard can only cast spells under certain conditions (e.g., only by day, near a favored element, no priests nearby). DM assigns 5–20 CP based on how frequently the restriction applies. Gain 5–20 CP.

wizard_restriction_supernatural_constrai.description: Restriction - Supernatural constraint (5+): Wizard has an unavoidable supernatural vulnerability — e.g., cannot cross running water, cannot enter a home without invitation, lost at crossroads. DM assigns 5–15 CP based on impact. Gain 5–15 CP.

wizard_restriction_talisman.description: Restriction - Talisman (8): Wizard's magical power is linked to a specific object (crystal, staff, amulet, ring, etc.); spells cannot be cast without it. If destroyed, 1d4 weeks of work creates a new one. Gain 8 CP.

wizard_restriction_weapons_restriction_c.description: Restriction - Weapons restriction (3): Restrict wizard weapon proficiencies to an explicit listed set of weapons.
Restriction - Weapons restriction (5): No weapon proficiencies allowed.

druid_pass_without_trace.description: Pass without trace (5): Gain pass without trace at 3rd level.

druid_fire_electrical_resistance.description: Fire/electrical resistance (5): +2 to saving throws vs fire and electricity.

druid_shapechange_cp10.description: Shapechange (10): Gain druid shapechanging progression; advanced version begins earlier.

druid_shapechange_cp15.description: Shapechange (15): Gain druid shapechanging progression; advanced version begins earlier.

druid_restriction_armor_restriction.description: Restriction - Armor restriction (5+): Druid is limited in armor choice. Chain mail or lighter (5 CP); studded leather or lighter (10 CP); no armor at all (15 CP). Gain 5, 10, or 15 CP.

druid_restriction_limited_armor_chain.description: Restriction - Limited armor (chain or lighter): Gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_limited_armor_studded.description: Restriction - Limited armor (studded leather or lighter): Gain 10 CP.

druid_restriction_awkward_casting_method.description: Restriction - Awkward casting method (5): Druid's spellcasting is obviously supernatural — glowing halo, peals of thunder, tremors, or nearby sensations alert any intelligent creature in earshot. Casting unobserved is nearly impossible. Gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_difficult_spell_acquis.description: Restriction - Difficult spell acquisition (5): Druid can pray for spells only under very specific circumstances (e.g., only in a sacred grove, only at certain celestial alignments, or after 3 days of fasting). Gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_hazardous_spells.description: Restriction - Hazardous spells (10): Channeling nature's power is dangerous; druid suffers 1 damage per spell level (save vs. breath for half), or has a 5%/level chance (−2%/character level, min 1%) of losing all spells and being feebleminded for 1d3 days. Gain 10 CP.

druid_restriction_limited_magical_item_u.description: Restriction - Limited magical item use (5+): Druid is banned from certain magical item categories. For each barred category — potions/oils/scrolls; rings; rods/staves/wands; miscellaneous magic; weapons and armor — gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_reduced_hit_points_cp1.description: Restriction - Reduced hit points (10): Uses d6 Hit Die instead of d8 (10 CP), or d4 Hit Die (20 CP). Gain 10 or 20 CP.

druid_restriction_reduced_hit_points_cp2.description: Restriction - Reduced hit points (20): Uses d6 Hit Die instead of d8 (10 CP), or d4 Hit Die (20 CP). Gain 10 or 20 CP.

druid_restriction_reduced_spell_progress.description: Restriction - Reduced spell progression (15): Druid memorizes one less spell of each level than normal; 1st-level druid gains 0 first-level spells, and no bonus Wisdom spells for reduced levels. Gain 15 CP.

druid_restriction_slower_casting_times.description: Restriction - Slower casting times (5): Druid's spells are long-winded; all casting times increase by 3, or casting times of 1 round or longer are doubled. Gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_weapon_restriction_cp5.description: Restriction - Weapon restriction (5): Druid further restricted to staff, club, war hammer, horseman's mace, and horseman's flail (5 CP); or may never gain proficiency in any weapon (15 CP). Gain 5 or 15 CP.

druid_restriction_weapon_restriction_cp1.description: Restriction - Weapon restriction (15): Druid further restricted to staff, club, war hammer, horseman's mace, and horseman's flail (5 CP); or may never gain proficiency in any weapon (15 CP). Gain 5 or 15 CP.

druid_restriction_behavior_taboo.description: Restriction - Behavior/taboo (2): Druid must follow an unusual code of conduct tied to nature (e.g., always speak a prayer before felling a tree, never enter a city); violating it requires penance to regain spells. Gain 2 CP.

druid_restriction_ceremony_observance.description: Restriction - Ceremony/observance (5): Druid must perform a daily natural ceremony (dawn meditation, moonrise ritual, etc.); missing it risks losing memorized spells or suffering divine disfavor from nature. Gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_fanaticism.description: Restriction - Fanaticism (5): Druid's faith is intolerant of those who despoil nature; refuses companions who cut forests or kill animals wantonly, and suffers −4 reaction with those who openly harm nature. Gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_limited_spell_selectio.description: Restriction - Limited spell selection (5): Druid must build a spell book like a wizard; spells per level capped by Intelligence, and a learn-spells roll is required to add each new nature spell. Gain 5 CP.

druid_restriction_talisman.description: Restriction - Talisman/symbol (8): Druid's power is focused through one sacred natural object (a specific stone, carved branch, or totem); without it, no spells can be cast. Creating a replacement takes 1d4 weeks of fasting and communion with nature. Gain 8 CP.

druid_woodland_stride.description: Woodland stride (6): Move through natural undergrowth unhindered and gain +1 surprise bonus.

druid_nature_ward.description: Nature ward (8): +1 to saves versus poison and disease.

access_to_spheres_standard_druid_package.description: Access to spheres: Standard druid package costs 60 CP, or buy spheres individually.
